_evidence.method: Read-only: PyMethodDef pointer scan over the engine file (Python, stdlib), then Ghidra 12.1.2 headless -noanalysis with native/bridge/analysis/InspectFlFunctions.java on the selected entry points. FL Studio was not started or injected.

armTrack.keywords: (index, value=-1): -1 toggles, else sets when different

chain.isTrackArmedRead: *(byte*)(MixerTrackArray + track * stride + armedOffset) with bounds 0..MixerTrackCount-1; 2025: stride 0x1474 (IMUL 0x51D, scale 4), armedOffset 0x145C; 2026: stride 0x1478 (IMUL 0x28F, scale 8), armedOffset 0x1470. Solo byte at +0x1A in the same wrappers agrees with the verified mixer layout.

armTrackCallback.behaviour: readiness vtable check (+0xa0), bounds check, value == -1 ? setter(trackStruct, armedByte == 0, 0) : (armedByte != value ? setter(trackStruct, value, 0) : nothing)

setterThunk.abi: Win64: RCX = trackStruct, DL = armed (Delphi Boolean), R8 = 0; forwards *(trackStruct + 0x1460 / 0x158) (recorder object) to the inner routine

innerRoutine.behaviour: writes the armed byte (MixerTrackArray + track*stride + armedOffset = armed), builds the recording name when arming (auto-name or dialog per FL settings; disarms itself if that fails), refreshes the mixer and notifies; third argument 0 as passed by FL's own callback

FLmx_SetTrackArmed.kind: SK_DataRef (CALL rel32 at pattern +64, instruction end +68)
